name: split-flap-text
title: Split Flap Text
description: Departure-board lettering. Tiles flip through a drum of letters on a hinge, one beat apart. Screen readers get the lines once.

props.name: words
props.description: Lines to show. With two or more, the board cycles through them. Letters outside A-Z, 0-9 and :.-/&!? become blanks.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds one flap takes to fall.

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds before the board starts cycling.

props.name: length
props.description: Tiles always shown. Defaults to the longest line.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the first line and never flips.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.

props.name: tileClassName
props.description: Classes for each tile, to recolor the board.
